punchline: Matthew Syed, one of England's best table tennis players, was humiliated at the 2000 Olympics and later explained why experts choke.
thirty_sec: At the Sydney Olympics in 2000, Matthew Syed played far below his best. He later explained choking with two brain systems. Skill lives in an implicit system. Under pressure control moves to the explicit system, which cannot do many things at once, so an expert starts to struggle with what he had mastered. It is like carrying a full glass of wine across an expensive carpet.
